title: Universal Input System
description: Standalone input processing system with trie-based key dispatch, modal editing, multi-key sequences, operator+motion composition, context-aware keymaps, mouse input, TOML config, macro recording, and Dioxus integration. Inspired by Zed, Helix, and Reaper-Keys. Two new crates: `input` (core) and `input-dioxus` (bridge).
